1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Eligibility criteria: 1. The bidder or the OEM of the product offered by the bidder shall have supplied the same or simi lar items for a minimum 20% of bid quantity in a single contract during last three years prior to an d excluding bid opening date to any zonal Railways or PSU or Govt organisation. Documentary evi dence i.e., Purchase Order must be furnished along with its R note copy or CRAC (Consignee Recei pt and Acceptance certificate) or any inspection certificate issued by any third party inspection ag ency i.e., RDSO or RITES or any inspection certificate signed by not less than a Gazette Officer. 2. Where the bidder relies upon the past supply performance of its OEM, the qualifying supply shal l relate to the same OEM whose product is being offered in the present bid. The bidder shall clearly identify the OEM and the offered product/model in its bid, and the documentary evidence shall est ablish that the qualifying supply was made by that OEM. 3. Clarification in respect of shortfall information shall be sought only for historical documents that existed prior to the date of tender opening and have remained unchanged thereafter. With regard to documents required for meeting the qualification criteria, after submission of the tender, only d ocuments relating to the shortfall already identified in the documents submitted by the bidder shal l be considered. No new document establishing a fresh qualification shall be permitted. For examp le, if a bidder has submitted a Supply Order but has not submitted the corresponding Completion Certificate/Performance Certificate, such certificate may be sought as a shortfall document and co nsidered. However, a new Supply Order, not submitted with the original tender, shall not be sough t or considered for the purpose of establishing the bidder's eligibility or qualification. .
